newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing early-Feb French wheat near $154.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing early-Feb French wheat near $154.

text.p: A European Union award of 343,100 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 14.90 Ecus per tonne values a tonne of early-February French wheat at $153.60 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
Implied fob price in dollars 153.60 dollars/tonne.
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $173.31 per tonne. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5146
